title: Replies and reactions name the latest version (mimi-content-10 §4.1 SHOULD)
description: Decision mimid-1wgh.85 as revised by Mark 2026-11-21. Today the store keeps only the first version's full MessageId; later edits keep 10 reference octets, and replies/reactions name the first version. Change: keep each version's full ID; a reply or reaction names the version the user saw (on JMAP: the Message's current version; on IRC: the latest version shown); receiving still resolves any version (first, later, or by reference octets). Update §7.26/§7.27; tests incl. a reply to an edited message seen by a receiver that missed the edit.
